mutants.why: dropping the _do_release call means y/Y in confirm_release silently does nothing; d1 asserts _do_release is called once with the target

mutants.name: release-first-hold-not-target
mutants.why: releasing the first class hold the state lists (not the confirm's named target) silently operates on the wrong plan; d1's state lists hold-a.md first while the target is hold-b.md, so assert_called_once_with(row_b) fails

mutants.name: release-before-footer-line
mutants.why: running _do_release before drawing the footer means the CEO sees no file name during the (up to two-minute) release; d2 asserts call_order == ['addstr', 'refresh', 'release']
mutants.anchor:
if stdscr is not None:
                    h, w = stdscr.getmaxyx()
                    footer_row = h - 1
                    msg = _fit(f"Releasing {self.release_target['file']} …", w)
                    stdscr.addstr(footer_row, 0, msg, curses.A_REVERSE)
                    stdscr.refresh()
                self._do_release(self.release_target)
